correctness.rationale: The renewal survival and first-reset generating series imply u_m=(gamma)_m/m! and exact beta-binomial ages. At gamma=1/2, the characteristic generating function is the Legendre generating function; the spin-flip concurrence equals its Fourier modulus. Legendre simple real roots give exactly t separability phases; the beta mixture and Hurwitz give the 2j_{0,k} scaling; Hilb gives the fixed-phase oscillatory t^{-1/2} envelope. Exact rational recursion and independent 4x4 spin-flip numerical checks passed in the bundled checker.
